items.title: Shell Garage
items.description: The first album as DayEXSO, featured on two tracks and fully produced by me. Was originally meant as a joke album, and was my first shot at hip-hop production. Listen here: https://ryringo.bandcamp.com/album/shell-garage

items.title: future:forward
items.description: My debut mixtape, produced, desgined, written and performed by me from December 2021 to May 2022. Released on 03/06/2022. Originally titled CODENAME:EXSO.
